subject.title: fix(github-copilot): reject unvalidated OAuth enterprise domain on refresh

question: Should legacy GitHub Copilot OAuth credentials carrying an off-allowlist enterpriseUrl be rejected across refresh and model routing until reauthentication, rather than normalized or migrated to github.com?
rationale: Both approaches alter shipped upgrade behavior around bearer credentials, and only repository security owners can authorize whether an invalid persisted credential must fail closed or receive a migration policy.

options.title: Approve fail-closed rejection
options.body: Reject the credential before every bearer-bearing route and require reauthentication, preserving the latest head's security boundary.

options.title: Require doctor-owned remediation
options.body: Add a non-destructive doctor policy approved by security owners before merge, without silently repointing the credential to github.com.

options.title: Pause the legacy OAuth path
options.body: Hold the PR while maintainers decide whether the obsolete OAuth credential shape should instead be removed or migrated more broadly.

recommendation.title: Approve fail-closed rejection
recommendation.body: Reject the credential before every bearer-bearing route and require reauthentication, preserving the latest head's security boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent auth-route and doctor repair history makes this the best available owner for the compatibility and recovery-policy choice.
